title: #241 Unwilling to Do
prompt: People sometimes should do things they aren’t willing to do. Discuss whether you agree with this statement or not.

promptSegments.text: People sometimes should do things they aren’t willing to do.
Discuss whether you agree with this statement or not.

requirements.en: State how far you agree or disagree.
requirements.vi: Nêu mức độ đồng ý hoặc không đồng ý.

requirements.en: Support your position with two clear reasons.
requirements.vi: Hỗ trợ quan điểm bằng hai lý do rõ ràng.

requirements.en: Use relevant examples when they strengthen an idea.
requirements.vi: Dùng ví dụ phù hợp khi chúng làm rõ ý.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The first point discusses how doing difficult tasks helps people grow and improve.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The first point discusses how doing difficult tasks helps people grow and improve.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The second point explains that doing things we dislike helps us become responsible and follow rules.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The second point explains that doing things we dislike helps us become responsible and follow rules.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Forcing people to do things against their will can cause pain.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Forcing people to do things against their will can cause pain.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Respecting personal choice is important because it maintains happiness.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Respecting personal choice is important because it maintains happiness.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Performing difficult tasks, even if boring, leads to important personal growth and helps us realize we can handle things we do not enjoy.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Performing difficult tasks, even if boring, leads to important personal growth and helps us realize we can handle things we do not enjoy.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Engaging in such actions builds strong character and resilience, exemplified by learning a new skill that requires practice despite difficulty.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Engaging in such actions builds strong character and resilience, exemplified by learning a new skill that requires practice despite difficulty.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Doing difficult tasks helps people grow and build mental strength.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Doing difficult tasks helps people grow and build mental strength.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Doing things against our wishes helps us build self-discipline and commitment.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Doing things against our wishes helps us build self-discipline and commitment.

promptTraps.en: Do not write a general essay about the topic without answering the exact task.

promptTraps.en: Do not explain the statement without making your own position clear.
promptTraps.vi: Không chỉ giải thích nhận định mà quên nêu rõ quan điểm cá nhân.
